title: SSC GD Constable Full Length Mock Test 05 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for SSC GD Constable. 80 Questions | 60 Minutes | Reasoning 20, GA 20, Maths 20, English 20.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 80 questions: General Intelligence and Reasoning 20, General Knowledge and GA 20, Elementary Mathematics 20, English 20.
Har question 2 marks ka hai. Galat jawab par 0.25 marks katenge.
SSC GD Constable latest pattern ke anusar.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If PAPER is coded as QBQFS, how is PENCIL coded?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Pointing to a boy, Rina said, He is the son of my grandfather's only son. How is the boy related to Rina?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A person walks 8 km East, then 6 km North, then 8 km West. How far is he from the start?
questions.explanation: East and West cancel; he is 6 km North of start.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the odd one out: 27, 64, 125, 216, 343, 512, 729, 1000, 1331, 1728, 2198
questions.explanation: All others are perfect cubes. 13 cubed is 2197, not 2198.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statements: All dogs are animals. Some animals are cats. Conclusions: I. Some dogs are cats. II. All animals are dogs.
questions.explanation: Some animals being cats does not imply dogs are cats. All animals are dogs is false.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If the word GUARD is seen in a mirror placed on the right side, which option represents the correct mirror image order of letters?
questions.explanation: A vertical mirror on the right reverses left-right order of letters: DRAUG with each letter laterally inverted.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Which diagram best represents Police, Constable, Officer?

questions.explanation: Constable and Officer are types of Police, so two subsets inside Police.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Five friends P, Q, R, S, T sit in a row. Q is between P and R. S is to the immediate right of R. T is at the extreme left. Who is in the middle?
questions.explanation: Order: T, P, Q, R, S. Middle is R.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If 15 August 2024 was Thursday, what day was 15 August 2025?
questions.explanation: 2024 to 2025 is 365 days = 1 odd day, so Friday.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: At what time between 3 and 4 o'clock are the hands of a clock at right angles for the first time?
questions.explanation: First right angle after 3 is at 16 4/11 minutes.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a row of 40 students, A is 16th from the left and B is 20th from the right. How many students are between A and B?
questions.explanation: B from left = 40-20+1=21. Between 16 and 21: 4 students.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statement: All that glitters is not gold. Conclusions: I. Gold does not glitter. II. Something that glitters may not be gold.
questions.explanation: The proverb means glittering things need not be gold. Only II follows.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A cube is painted red on all faces and cut into 27 smaller equal cubes. How many small cubes have exactly two faces painted?
